hook: Nonnegative weak tilings can satisfy condition (T1) but fail (T2), with an explicit case in Z_180
summary: Researchers build a general method for finding nonnegative functions on finite cyclic groups that meet the Coven-Meyerowitz condition (T1) but not (T2) while acting as a weak complement to a tile. They also show that a tile with an unsupported divisor has a dilation with such a complement, and give an explicit example in the group of order 180. The examples are not positive definite, so they leave open the positive-definite extension of the conditions.
title: Nonnegative weak tilings and the Coven-Meyerowitz condition (T2)
